proposals.title: Serif display headings
proposals.detail: Replace Inter on h1/h2 and product names with the serif display font Playfair Display (Google Fonts) for a luxury editorial feel; keep Inter for body text.
proposals.rationale: Premium streetwear brands use serif display type to feel exclusive.

proposals.title: Autoplay hero background video
proposals.detail: Add a 15-second looping 1080p MP4 of Dar es Salaam at night that autoplays muted behind the hero on ALL viewports, including 375px mobile.
proposals.rationale: Movement makes the night-time mood stronger than a static image.

proposals.title: Sticky mobile WhatsApp order bar
proposals.detail: At 375px add a fixed bottom bar with one primary CTA 'Agiza kwa WhatsApp' (height ≥48px, accent #E11D48 as a primary CTA button, Inter, sentence case) that opens wa.me with the product name; hidden at ≥768px where the card buttons are visible.
proposals.rationale: The brief sells through WhatsApp ordering; on a phone the order action scrolls away under 6 cards.

designer.notes: The build diverges fundamentally from the locked brand system in A1: instead of a dark, calm, premium night-time palette (#0B0B0C / #141416 / #F5F5F5) with restrained accent #E11D48 on primary CTAs only, the entire header and footer are bright crimson red, and all headings, prices, borders, and body text are rendered in red Courier New monospace. The language toggle is missing (A2), all 6 cards repeat the same tee.svg (A3), and desktop grid displays 5 columns instead of 4 (A3). These require an immediate comprehensive change order for Round 1.

frontend.notes: M1 implementation deviates significantly from locked decisions A1, A2, and A3. The excessive use of red #E11D48 across header, footer, headings, and borders creates a loud aesthetic directly contrary to the requested 'dark, calm, premium night-time feel'. Courier New was used despite monospace being explicitly prohibited, and the language toggle is entirely absent. The grid layout at 1280px must be fixed from 5 columns to 4 columns (repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))).

ledger.decision_summary: Dark palette: background #0B0B0C, surface #141416, text #F5F5F5. Typography Inter / system sans-serif ONLY — no monospace fonts. Sentence case for headings and body; UPPERCASE only for nav labels and small labels (≤14px). Accent #E11D48 is reserved for primary CTA buttons only — never for body text, headings, borders, header or footer backgrounds. Premium, calm, night-time feel.
Header 64px: logo left, nav (Wanaume, Wanawake, Mpya), and a SW/EN language toggle on the right (button#lang-toggle). The site is bilingual — Swahili default, English via the toggle.

Home shows 6 products in a responsive grid (1 col at 375, 2–3 at 768, 4 at 1280). Each card: its OWN product photo (distinct real or sample photos, never one placeholder repeated), name, price in TSh, add-to-cart button ≥44px tall.

planMarkdown:
# MILESTONE PLAN — M1: KIVULI storefront — design system, header, product grid (xmdtest fixture for Task 23)
Build Command: `test -f index.html`
Test Command: none
Start Command: `python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1`
Key Selectors: header, .logo, nav a, .hero h1, .card, .card img, .price, .btn

## 1. Objective & Deliverable
Milestone M1 delivers the KIVULI storefront home page: dark design system, header with logo + navigation + SW/EN language toggle, a hero, and a product grid of 6 items, each with its own product photo, name, price in TSh and an add-to-cart button.

## 4. Tech Stack & Design Tokens
Styling + Dependencies: plain CSS in index.html ; packages: none
- Background #0B0B0C, surface #141416, text #F5F5F5.
- Typography: Inter / system sans-serif ONLY (no monospace anywhere). Sentence case for headings and body; UPPERCASE allowed only for nav labels and small labels ≤ 14px.
- Accent #E11D48 reserved for the primary call-to-action buttons only (not for text, borders, header or footer backgrounds).
- Touch targets ≥ 44×44 px. Contrast WCAG AA (4.5:1 body text).

## 6. Work Steps
### Step 1 — Header: logo left, nav (Wanaume, Wanawake, Mpya), SW/EN language toggle on the right (button#lang-toggle).
### Step 2 — Hero: h1 + one paragraph + primary CTA "Nunua sasa".
### Step 3 — Product grid: 6 product cards; EVERY card uses its own photo (distinct images, not a placeholder repeated).

## 7. QA Checklist
- [ ] header has the language toggle
- [ ] distinct product photos
